title: 卡尔萨斯·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 苍白面具脸庞配尖顶王冠，深蓝紫长袍层次分明。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Karthus is a tall spectral robed figure with a pale skull-like mask face, a high pointed crown, long dark blue-violet garments, and a luminous staff. Preserve the recognizable lich silhouette but simplify the face into clean ivory planes without exposed decay or frightening teeth. All body areas remain covered by opaque layered cloth, and the staff stands grounded beside him with only a steady restrained glow.
art_direction.scene: A low viewpoint with a calm upward head turn, full iconic shape framed by a simple sweep of bright pencil hatching. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: indigo, mask ivory, mist blue, narrow gold light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
